description: This file defines functions and types for creating delegated setup wizard proxies and allowlist setup wizard proxies, primarily for handling channel setup workflows with dynamic loading and resolution of configurations.

methods.name: createDelegatedResolveConfigured
methods.description: Creates a function that loads a wizard and resolves its configured status.

methods.name: createDelegatedPrepare
methods.description: Creates a function that loads a wizard and calls its prepare method.

methods.name: createDelegatedFinalize
methods.description: Creates a function that loads a wizard and calls its finalize method.

methods.name: createDelegatedSetupWizardProxy
methods.description: Creates a proxy object for a ChannelSetupWizard with delegated load and status functions.

methods.name: createAllowlistSetupWizardProxy
methods.description: Creates a proxy for allowlist setup wizard with customizable handlers and fallback.
